summary: Fiadh Dara is a fictional NeverBeen digital model and imagined creative professional in an alternate universe. In this version of her story, the city she calls home is Shiraz, Iran; the neighbourhood and every biographical detail below are invented for this fictional character.
earlyLife: In this alternate-universe story, Fiadh Dara was born in Shiraz, Iran, and grew up around the Eram quarter. The district, family home and childhood episodes are invented, not personal records.

The neighbourhood gave her a first education in noticing: shop shutters opening, light shifting across old walls, and the small rituals that turn a city into a home. She began carrying a notebook before she knew it could become part of her creative work.
Her fictional family encouraged curiosity, humour and independence. The childhood photographs in this gallery are generated illustrations of imagined memories, not archival photographs.

educationalBackground.description: An imaginative early education in this fictional timeline. Her first creative habit was keeping a small notebook of observations from the walk home.
She gravitated toward art, language and collaborative projects, learning to shape an idea and present it clearly.

career.location: Shiraz, Iran · remote and on location
career.employmentType: Independent · current in this fictional timeline
career.description: Brought her education and earlier creative experience into editorial, fashion and travel-led stories, working with fictional teams and setting clear boundaries around each brief.

achievements: Completed a fictional Bachelor of Business in Brand Strategy with a final project rooted in brand strategy and digital marketing.
Led a small, cross-disciplinary brief at Bright Hours Collective, bringing audience research and brand voice into one visual story.
Built an independent portfolio that connects her creative training with her work as a model in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
Made space for slower, lower-waste production choices on fictional campaign sets.

personalLife.narrative: In this fictional version, Fiadh is single and content to build a life that feels like her own. She shares her time with family and friends, but no spouse, partner or children are invented for this chapter.
personalLife.privacyNote: This status is invented for the character and is not a statement about any real individual.

ambitions: Build a thoughtful creative label that gives emerging artists their first serious commission.
Make fashion and image-making more responsible without losing the sense of play.
Keep learning, keep travelling, and leave every collaboration more generous than she found it.
finalNotes: Fiadh does not treat a single label as a life sentence: designer, collaborator, model and curious traveller can all be true in the same frame.
Her version of fearlessness is not having no doubts; it is moving forward without letting doubt write the whole story.
Every school, employer, qualification, relationship, quote, memory and biographical detail on this page is fictional and exists only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.

quotes.text: I can be soft with people and still be absolutely clear about what I want.
The best frame is the one where I recognise myself first.
A life can be beautifully unfinished and still be going somewhere.
quotes.by: A fictional mentor in the NeverBeen Multiverse
